$comment: Publication approval for official releases (docs/RELEASING.md). CI publishes only when enabled is true AND every required gate is approved by the owner. Never set approved to true without the decision recorded in note.

applicationLicense.note: BLOCKED: the application has no published licence (no LICENSE file). The owner must choose the terms under which the executable may be downloaded and used, and add the licence text.

ffmpegLgpl.note: BLOCKED: the executable embeds an unmodified LGPL FFmpeg build. The package ships the LGPL text (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt) and the source pointers (SOURCE.md); the owner must confirm this meets the obligations for public distribution.

canonRedistribution.note: BLOCKED for the canon variant: no written authorization from Canon to redistribute the EDSDK publicly. The standard variant does not contain the SDK and does not need this gate.

codeSigning.note: No code-signing certificate. Releases are published with signed: false and the website says the executable is not code-signed.
